description: Use this when the user names a French company (or gives a SIREN or SIRET) and you need to identify it: returns up to 20 matches with name, SIREN, status, legal form code, NAF code and head-office city. Name matching is a prefix match on the official name. Do not use for people, officers or shareholders, and do not use it to list companies by sector or area.
name: search_companies
title: Search French companies
